blog_posts.title: Hello World!
blog_posts.content: It seems like I finally have the web page I wanted. I think at some point I'll figure out a way to add images to my project posts, but for now, I am just really happy that I got this thing running the way I wanted. My head is hurting, but I have my lunch meal prep done for the rest of the week, and I am ready to just lie down. I think I will be stuck awake for a little bit longer, though.

projects.title: Minecraft Server
projects.desc: Building a community server in hardcore, with a weekly respawn.

logs.title: Opening My First Project
logs.content: I'm hoping to get started on this project Friday after I get off work. Throughout the week, I might do some conceptual breakdowns and map out the different scripts I need—like an update script and eventually the respawn script—to figure out how they will look. I might also do some brainstorming on other ideas, such as deciding whether to make it a modded server. I'm a bit concerned about the system requirements, though, since I won't be running it on a very powerful computer.
